title: Bounded OpenCode-compatible live provider adapter contract

request_response.request: one bounded operation, opaque input digest, unique request id
request_response.response: one correlated status and opaque output digest
request_response.correlation: request id and exact request/response digests
request_response.replay: reject duplicate request, response, or lifecycle sequence

failure_semantics.interruption: require acknowledged interruption and fenced resume
failure_semantics.live_unavailable: local qualification with remote verification unverified

limitations: The harness validates synthetic observations only and never starts OpenCode, a process, provider, network, LLM, or tool.
Capability admission is not provider authorization and does not validate a Coordinator lease.
A passing fixture is not live execution, hosted CI, AWQ acceptance, AWG decision, UI approval, or durable-state completion.
follow_up: AWQ must independently qualify any evidence before live integration.
AWG must decide material provider and recovery alternatives; UI decisions require a private revision-bound session.
A later integration change must provide Coordinator lease, host enforcement, credential, network, and provider evidence separately.
